name: AgentMemory
tagline: Persistent project memory across coding sessions
description: Save decisions, lessons, and project context, then retrieve them in later coding sessions. The AgentMemory daemon provides 54 MCP tools with local keyword recall that requires no API key.

env.name: AGENTMEMORY_URL
env.description: AgentMemory server URL; defaults to http://localhost:3111.

env.name: AGENTMEMORY_SECRET
env.description: Server authentication secret when not using automatic local credential discovery.

install.notes: Requires Node.js 20 or newer. Start the full daemon separately with `npx -y @agentmemory/agentmemory@0.9.33`; the default endpoint is http://localhost:3111. Without a reachable daemon, the MCP package provides a reduced seven-tool local fallback. Loopback connections discover the local daemon credential automatically; remote servers require HTTPS and AGENTMEMORY_SECRET. With the daemon running, saved content goes to that server; optional model and embedding providers process data only when configured.
